summary: Enterprise software mid-transition into capital-intensive AI cloud. Two things break the standard template: years of buybacks drove shareholders' equity negative or near-zero, making ROE/P-B meaningless; and a capex surge ($40B construction in progress) is turning historically fat free cash flow negative. Judge it on EV-based multiples, RPO growth, and cash generation before versus after the buildout.
removed_add_tags_note: Carried an add_tags entry appending DebtLongtermAndShorttermCombinedAmount and UnsecuredDebt to long_term_debt. Removed: the vocabulary keeps the first off the analyze surface because it already contains the current portion, which this page adds separately as current_debt, and the second is a debt component that may stand for a total only where no total resolved. Neither ever won for Oracle - an earlier concept resolves in all 18 annual years and all 3 quarters - so removing them changes no figure. See vocabulary.template_conflicts.

metrics.label: Operating cash flow less D&A-level capex
metrics.why: Reported FCF now nets out a datacenter buildout far above maintenance needs, so it measures the investment cycle rather than the earning power of the installed base. Charging capex at the D&A run-rate approximates maintenance capex and shows what the business throws off before growth spending.
metrics.evidence: FY2026 10-K: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentGross $122.7B with ConstructionInProgressGross $40.0B, versus PP&E net $100.0B — capex is running far ahead of depreciation.

annotations.equity: Sustained buybacks have driven shareholders' equity to negative or near-zero. Book value carries no information here, and any ratio using it as a denominator is meaningless.
annotations.roe: Not meaningful — equity is negative or near-zero from buybacks, so the ratio is an artifact of capital structure rather than a return.
annotations.gross_profit: Oracle stopped tagging cost of revenue after FY2011 and gross profit after FY2018, so the gross-margin series is largely unavailable. This is a disclosure gap, not a deterioration.
annotations.fcf: Depressed since FY2025 by AI/cloud capex, not by operating weakness — see the maintenance-capex-adjusted line.

caveats: cost_of_revenue is tagged only 2009-2011 and gross_profit only 2015-2018; long-run margin analysis is not possible from XBRL for this filer.

Remaining performance obligation reached $638B in FY2026 (RevenueRemainingPerformanceObligation) — larger than 2x total assets and the single most important forward indicator for Oracle, but it is not currently a tracked metric.
Debt is tagged under DebtLongtermAndShorttermCombinedAmount ($129.5B) which the global mapping missed; this template adds it.
